# canary add call-plan --help · COLUMNS=80 · colour off
canary add call-plan — Size an exact long call or protective put using broker
fee evidence; no orders placed

Usage: canary add call-plan [--json] < request.json

Flags
  --json                    emit checked call size

Stdin: one JSON object; unknown fields and extra objects are rejected. Output is
always JSON, with or without --json.

contract (required): copy the exact contract returned by add market. It must be
a USD SMART option: sec_type OPT, right C or P, multiplier 100, positive con_id,
trading_class and expiry YYYYMMDD more than seven days away; retain symbol and
strike.

A put is sized within the held shares it may still protect; cover_capped says
that held the size.

limit_price (required): positive premium per underlying share in USD. budget
(required): positive total USD debit including the broker fee bound, at most
1000000000.

round_size (optional boolean, default false): round to the nearest five
contracts, retaining one or two. Rounding can exceed budget; inspect
over_budget, debit, quantity and fee_bound in the result.

The options session must be open. Sizing returns no submission token and
reserves no money. An exact order preview and separate owner confirmation are
required to place an order.

Example (synthetic identity; replace with your resolved contract):
canary add call-plan --json <<'JSON'
{
  "contract": {
    "symbol": "SYNA",
    "con_id": 10001,
    "sec_type": "OPT",
    "currency": "USD",
    "exchange": "SMART",
    "expiry": "20300118",
    "strike": 100,
    "right": "C",
    "multiplier": 100,
    "trading_class": "SYNA"
  },
  "limit_price": 5.5,
  "budget": 5000,
  "round_size": false
}
JSON
